annotations.title: One finding, with its evidence strength explained

description: One finding by its id (the last part of a permalink, /e/{id}): the claim, its evidence strength and what that level means, the verbatim quote, the study design and the paper, and evidence_strength_reasons: each rule that set the level, in order, and what the assessment does not weigh. Use it to explain why the evidence behind a finding is as strong as it is, from evidence_strength_reasons rather than by guessing.

finding_id.description: A 26-character finding id, from a permalink or get_findings.
